items.name: 翡翠书环
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production selectable knowledge-planet icon for KeLing, a Chinese interstellar pixel-art learning app. Create exactly ONE whole planet, not a sheet or grid. Square 1024x1024 transparent RGBA canvas. Cohesive hand-crafted 32-bit retro game pixel art, deliberate large square pixel clusters, crisp stepped dark navy outlines, restrained 3-level flat shading, no smooth gradients, no blur, no photorealism, no tiny text. Shared palette: navy #14263D, mint #72D8C3, ivory #FFF6DF, coral #EF987D, gold #F4CE72 with restrained subject-specific accents. Readable as a 64px UI icon. Planet and all accessories centered within 78% of canvas, even generous transparent safe margin, lighting from upper left. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, backdrop or checkerboard. Real transparent background. Subject: a mint emerald ocean planet with a wide ivory ring sweeping diagonally around it, open-book continent shapes and two tiny gold satellites; distinctive horizontal ring silhouette.
